entries.I’m Mari. Got the same orders as you; gu: I’m Mari. Got the same orders as you; I suppose someone wanted an officer with experience to keep an eye on you and your ‘fresh’ company. Can’t imagine why.
entries.Well, orders are orders. Come on over he: Well, orders are orders. Come over here, Deoran — let’s get a closer look at you.
entries.Move Deoran next to Mari first!\n(press:
Move Deoran next to Mari first!

entries.Wondering about those percentages that a: Wondering about those percentages that appear on the ground when you move a unit? That’s your soldiers’ terrain defence — their chance to evade enemy attacks.
entries.In Wesnoth, every attack has a chance to: In Wesnoth, every attack has a chance to miss. Units on favourable terrain (such as castles, villages, forest, or hills) are more likely to evade attacks, while units on poor terrain (such as water, sand, or ice) are much easier to hit. Different units receive different benefits from terrain. Most infantry, for example, have 50% evasion in forest — but cavalry only have 30%. For details, right-click on a unit and select ‘Unit Type Description.’ For the most advantageous fights, try to position your units on good terrain, and attack your enemies while they’re on poor terrain!
entries.You have fifty pounds of armor and a hor: You have fifty pounds of armour and a horse, rookie. I’m fairly sure you’ll win.
entries.Why not? It’s a magical quintain, on loa: Why not? It’s a magical quintain, on loan from the wizards’ academy at Alduin. It strikes twice per attack, and will fiercely sting if it hits you. Brace yourself!
entries.To end your turn, click the <b>“End Turn: To end your turn, click the ‘End Turn’ button in the bottom-right corner of the screen, or press Ctrl+Space.
entries.Move to a village first!\n(press “u” if:
Move to a village first!
(press ‘u’ if you need to undo a move)
entries.You’ve captured a village, which now fli: You’ve captured a village, which now flies the red-and-white colours of our banner. Each village we own provides us with some income — and importantly for you, provides a place to rest and recover.
entries.Starting your turn in a village will <b>: Starting your turn in a village will heal you for 8 hit-points. End your turn now.
entries.Congratulations, you ran away from the d: Congratulations, you ran away from the dummy and tended to your wounds in a village. I hope you’re proud.
entries.Use “Ctrl+R” to recruit a soldier first!:
Use ‘Ctrl+R’ to recruit a soldier first!
(press ‘u’ if you need to undo a move)
entries.The quintain is repairing itself! Come o: The quintain is repairing itself! Come on men, let’s finish it off!
entries.In addition to the +8 healing provided b:
In addition to the +8 healing provided by a village, units will also regenerate 2 hit-points if they spend their turn resting: neither moving nor fighting.

This ‘rest-healing’ stacks with village healing.
entries.Tip: Press “u” if you ever want to undo: Tip: Press ‘u’ if you ever want to undo a move. Attacks cannot be undone.
entries.We’re going to have to cut things short,: We will have to cut things short, rookie. Look: bandits on the south road!
entries.Oh, what’s this? A lady and her loyal sq: Oh, what’s this? A lady and her loyal squire travellin’ south on this dangerous road? Tell ya what, we can offer ya protection ’round here for a small fee.
entries.You may toggle tips on or off at any tim: You may toggle tips on or off at any time during the campaign by right-clicking anywhere and selecting ‘Tips: On/Off’ in the menu.

You may toggle tips on or off at any time during the campaign by right-clicking anywhere and selecting ‘Tips: On/Off’ in the menu.

Because you skipped the tutorial, tips are currently off.
entries.Every turn, the time of day changes,\naf: Every turn, the time of day changes, affecting how much damage units do. In this campaign, most of your units will be deadliest during the day, while most of your enemies will be deadliest at night. See the current time of day and its effects by hovering over the right-side panel.
entries.You are beaten, you bloodthirsty, baldin: You are beaten, you bloodthirsty, balding bandit! Accosting travellers between Weldyn and Westin; what is the meaning of this? How have you become so bold as to strike at even trained soldiers!?
entries.Another Urza brother, augmenting his ran: Another Urza brother, augmenting his ranks with the restless dead. The brothers must have been waiting on the road for travellers, ambushing civilians and raising their corpses as minions.
entries.I know banditry is not uncommon in the l: I know banditry is not uncommon in the lawless south, but necromancy!? Where is the rest of the South Guard? How have things got so far out of control?
entries.Let’s find out. Deoran, you and your men: Let’s find out. Deoran, you and your men deal with this bandit. Anyone who dies to those zombies will become one themselves, so don’t be stupid and remember what we practised:
entries.Recalling and leveling-up soldiers is ve:
Recalling and advancing soldiers is very important. By recalling
veterans every scenario and building up their experience, over
time you can create a very powerful army.
entries.Ha, this zombie is so slow and weak! Usu: Ha, this zombie is so slow and weak! Usually, moving next to an enemy unit prevents me from moving any further. But this frail, feeble Walking Corpse is easy to outmanoeuvre.
entries.Other than that singular piece of inform:
Other than that singular piece of information, I regret to report that Urza Fastik remains as recalcitrant as the day we first arrived.

Whether ‘The Vale of Blossoming Trees’ refers to the source of his dark powers, the location of another Urza brother, or something else entirely, I cannot say.
entries.Aye, officially these lands belong to Pr: Aye, officially these lands belong to Prince Arand; King Garard’s younger brother. Arand’s been tryin’ to build up the place. Last time he visited, His Highness said our home might someday be called the Jewel of the South!
entries.Well, if we don’t have any other leads,: Well, if we don’t have any other leads, then we’ll need to investigate this ‘Vale of Blossoming Trees’ and hope it’s neither misdirection nor a trap. Sirs, do I have your permissions to take the infantry on a sortie?
entries....but I guess you’re asking about my sk: ...but I suppose you’re asking about my skills, not yours. You never did get a chance to see me fight.
entries.Mari has unusually high terrain defenses: Mari has unusually high terrain defences (her chance to evade enemy attacks). Her skirmisher ability lets her ignore enemies’ Zone of Control — she can move freely around enemy units without being stopped.
entries.Got a pretty good sling too, ’cuz there: Got a pretty good sling too, ’cos there aren’t many ranged weapons that can be loaded single-handedly. Altogether, I’ll bet I could outlast both Hylas and Gerrick in a 1-on-1. And you too, but that goes without saying.
entries.Born twisted, I’m afraid. At the time th:
Born twisted, I’m afraid. At the time there was no healer in Westin, and the bones set poorly.

Such was the greater part of my motivation for travelling to the Isle of Alduin and studying the arcane arts — an opportunity to return home and offer to others the services that I never had.
entries.I’ve long-ago accepted my impairment. Bu: I’ve long-ago accepted my impairment. But as my potential commander, you should know that it does somewhat slow my movement on the battlefield, even more so than is Sir Gerrick by his armour.
entries.An’ while my armor may be heavy an’ cumb: An’ while my armour may be heavy an’ cumbersome, it also gives me great resistance against bladed or piercing weapons. If you need someone t’ break an enemy line, I’m your man.
entries.Each attack in Wesnoth has a damage type: Each attack in Wesnoth has a damage type: blade, pierce, impact, fire, cold, or arcane. Some units have resistances or vulnerabilities to certain types of damage. Walking Corpses, for example, are vulnerable to arcane damage. To see a unit’s resistances, right-click on it and select ‘Unit Type Description.’
entries.Well, like I said, I’ve got great damage: Well, like I said, I’ve got great damage resistance on account o’ me heavy armour, an’ I can slow enemies t’ halve both their speed an’ damage. Try not t’ forget this time!
entries.Given the evidence at hand, Deoran, I be: Given the evidence at hand, Deoran, I believe the answer is ‘yes.’
entries.This is no bandit, for these humans bear: This is no bandit, for these humans bear the banner of the South Guard, not those rags of the Urzas. Though it remains to be seen whether this is an improvement — why do you enter the hallowed isle of Elrath?
entries.—but, but, I have scarcely been here a m: —but, but, I have scarcely been here a month! I could not have acted on something that began before my arrival! And besides, this is not the fault of ‘my kind’ but of the Urza brothe—
entries....honorable elves, I am Commander Deora: ...honourable elves, I am Commander Deoran, of Westin’s South Guard. I cannot speak for the past, but in the present we need your help.
entries....very well, outlander. The challenge i: ...very well, out-lander. The challenge is passed. Enter, and greet us as we are in life.
entries.Undead! In an elven valley?? And a caged: Undead! In an elven valley? And a caged elf, too!
entries.To recruit units, you must first move De:
To recruit units, you must first move Deoran on to a keep.
    There are two elven keeps near the centre of the map.
entries.<i>Rain or snow have no impact on gamepl: Rain or snow have no impact on game-play. If weather is distracting or reduces performance, you can disable it by opening the Preferences menu (Ctrl-P), by selecting “Display” and unselecting ‘‘Animate Map.’
entries.But what’s this? I’ve arrived just in ti: But what’s this? I’ve arrived just in time, for we have guests, human guests! Welcome, welcome. I’m so pleased to have visitors, for I’ve not seen a living soul since the last of my living followers joined the hordes of eternal unlife.
entries.You always were the cruelest of my capto: You always were the cruellest of my captors, Urza Nalmath. May your creator have mercy on you now that I am free, for I will not!
entries.Ethiliel, you poor, deluded girl. You of: Ethiliel, you poor, deluded girl. You of all people should know just how many undead I’ve raised from the ruins of your little village. You and I and all your new human friends are going to have such fun together...
entries.Vermin! Scum! You black-souled degenerat: Vermin! Scum! You black-souled degenerate! You always were the cruellest of my captors, Urza Nalmath. May your creator have mercy on you once I get free, for I will not!
entries.But I certainly can’t allow you to be fr: But I certainly can’t allow you to be freed by these human visitors. You of all people should know just how many undead I’ve raised from the ruins of your little village. You and I and all your new human friends are going to have such fun together...
entries.Most scenarios have a turn limit, as\nsh: Most scenarios have a turn limit, as shown in the upper left-hand corner. Usually, running out of turns will result in defeat — check your objectives by clicking the ‘Menu’ button in the top-left corner (or use the hot-key Ctrl+J). Finishing early will usually reward a gold boost (‘early finish bonus’) in the next scenario, so don’t delay! In this scenario, your objective is to survive until turns run out.
entries.In fog, <b><i>units can see 1 hex furthe: In fog, units can see 1 hex further than their movement. Fast units, such as Deoran, make for great scouts. Exploring in fog will prevent you from using ‘undo’, so be careful where you move!
entries.Have you been wondering\nwhat effect the: Have you been wondering what effect these cliffs have on game-play? They... don’t actually do anything. But they do look pretty! (or at least we devs think so)
entries.Wesnoth has many settings and hotkeys. T: Wesnoth has many settings and hot-keys. To see all available options, select the Menu or Actions buttons in the top-left corner. Here are some of the most useful:
entries.• To change a scenario’s difficulty with: • To change a scenario’s difficulty without restarting the entire campaign, load a game and select the Change Difficulty option. This option is only available when loading from the start of a scenario — the save file named ‘TSG-Vale of Tears.gz’, not ‘TSG-Vale of Tears-Auto-Save7.gz’
entries.By Haldric, they’re real! The old-timers: By Haldric, they’re real! The old-timers used to talk about fighting bloated, half-dead, half-alive ‘ghouls’... they say it takes but one scratch to poison a man half-dead, unless healed at a village or by a healer like Ethiliel.
entries.Nnrrgh!! No, I created you! Attack them,: Nnrrgh! No, I created you! Attack them, not me! The master never taught me how to control these things!
entries.I know it’s tough to accept, Ethiliel, b: I know it’s tough to accept, Ethiliel, but if your sage was taken into the Black Forest he’s probably not coming back out. You say it’s been months, and neither the Urza brothers nor their mysterious ‘master’ seem the type to take prisoners — present company excluded.
entries.Aye, he were alive then, but is he now?: Aye, he were alive then, but is he now? The Black Forest, Ethiliel... an’ you say it’s been months? Neither th’ Urza brothers nor tha’ mysterious ‘master’ seem th’ type t’ take prisoners — present company aside, o’ course.
entries.I fear the odds are not in your sage’s f: I fear the odds are not in your sage’s favour, Ethiliel. The Black Forest oft attracts evil, and neither the Urza brothers nor their mysterious ‘master’ have shown an inclination for prisoners — present company excluded.
entries.Deoran, we’ve got some brawny lads among: Deoran, we’ve got some brawny lads among us. They’re good men, willing to learn, an’ on the march I’ve been training ’em to fight in heavy armour.
entries.We came here to fight the bandits, but f: We came here to fight the bandits, but for them to have perished on their own? Something feels quite wrong here...
entries.What, do women not count as “living”? Yo: What, do women not count as ‘living’? You Urzas have caused enough havoc with your undead raising, and I am fed up with it. Prepare to join your brothers, boy.
entries.It was “never your intention”!? You loat: It was ‘never your intention’!? You loathsome vermin locked me in a cage! You dragged Mebrin off in chains; my kind, gentle teacher! Deoran, why are we stooping so low as to even speak with this pig?
entries.But there was one who we captured; a pow:
But there was one who we captured; a powerful and magical sage. Away from his people, he offered to teach us the secrets o’ summonin’ the dead.

I saw the folly in doing such a thing, but my brothers were weak an’ foolish, and soon fell under the sway of the corrupting magic — becomin’ thralls of the very elf they’d sought to enslave. They called him ‘master’, and went from here to do his bidding.
entries.Author’s note — this is a “secret” path,: Author’s note — this is a ‘secret’ path, and somewhat more challenging than the regular options. Are you sure you want to proceed?
entries.The old elf’s cave is southeast of m’ ca: The old elf’s cave is south-east of m’ camp. My outlaws’ll fight his shamblin’ hordes, but I leave it up to you soldiers to push into Mebrin’s cave and strike the finishin’ blow.
entries.Mad? I am furious!! You accursed mudling: Mad? I am furious! You accursed mudlings took me and tormented me, tortured me for sport! I did not know day from night... the light and the shadows, heat and cold all bled together amidst my pain...
entries.You thought me weak; powerless under you: You thought me weak; powerless under your lash. But I have had my revenge — I tought the summoning of powers beyond the control of your feeble kin, powers that fed upon your race’s filth and greed. I knew that once the first strand of black magic left my hands, there would be no turning back. But I would suffer this humiliation no longer...
entries.Mad? I am furious!! You accursed mudling: Mad? I am furious! You accursed mudlings took me and tormented me, tortured me for sport! I knew that once the first strand of black magic left my hands, there would be no turning back. But I would suffer this humiliation no longer...
entries.As the scalpel cuts away a tumor, so sha: As the scalpel cuts away a tumour, so shall I cut your corruption out of this world. Your blight is ended, Mebrin of the elves.
entries.You are running out of turns to complete: You are running out of turns to complete this scenario! See your objectives by pressing Ctrl+J, and remember that the turn limit can be seen in the top left-hand corner.
entries.This is our reward for killing the lich?: This is our reward for killing the lich? Should have expected that no good deed would go unpunished. Ethiliel must be a sore loser — she’s returned to the Aethenwood and blamed us for what happened to her village and her mentor.
entries.Elvish Rangers have the powerful\n<b><i>: Elvish Rangers have the powerful ‘ambush’ ability! The ambush ability makes a Ranger invisible while in forest, unless you have a unit next to it. Watch out for hit-and-run attacks!
entries.Mad? I am furious!! Those accursed mudli: Mad? I am furious! Those accursed mudlings took me and tormented me, tortured me for sport! I knew that once the first strand of black magic left my hands, there would be no turning back. But I would suffer this humiliation no longer...
entries.What other option do we have, Captain Ma: What other option do we have, Captain Mari? ‘Mal M’Brin’ had made it clear he blames all humanity for his suffering. Even if we could escape ourselves, Westin is completely unprepared for an attack!
entries.What other option do we have, Sir Gerric: What other option do we have, Sir Gerrick? ‘Mal M’Brin’ had made it clear he blames all humanity for his suffering. Even if we could escape ourselves, Westin is completely unprepared for an attack!
entries.What other option do we have, Minister H: What other option do we have, Minister Hylas? ‘Mal M’Brin’ had made it clear he blames all humanity for his suffering. Even if we could escape ourselves, Westin is completely unprepared for an attack!
entries.Get out of here, Deoran. Leave me the fe: Get out of here, Deoran. Leave me the few men you’ve already recruited, but take the others and warn Westin. I’ll make a stand here. We’ll slow ’em down as much as we can.
entries.Then there’s only one thing we can do. S: Then there’s only one thing we can do. Sir, you must hasten back to Westin t’ warn the garrison. I’ll command the defence here. Leave me th’ few men ye’ve already recruited, and we’ll hold back the undead as long as we can.
entries.Then our course of action is clear. Deor: Then our course of action is clear. Deoran, take the bulk of our company and return to Westin. Warn the garrison and rally a defence. My bad leg would only slow you down — I shall remain behind with the few men you’ve already recruited, and delay the undead as best we can.
entries.I... I understand. I will ride with all: I... I understand. I will ride with all haste to Westin, to rally the garrison and make ready the defence. Captain Mari, we shall return as soon as we can, and surely relieve you!
I... I understand. I will ride with all haste to Westin, to rally the garrison and make ready the defence. Sir Gerrick, we shall return as soon as we can, and surely relieve you!
I... I understand. I will ride with all haste to Westin, to rally the garrison and make ready the defence. Minister Hylas, we shall return as soon as we can, and surely relieve you!
entries.friend_is_female^We’ll never forget your: We’ll never forget your sacrifice here. Thank you, my friend.
entries.friend_is_male^We’ll never forget your s: We’ll never forget your sacrifice here. Thank you, my friend.
entries.Just because you can attack\ndoesn’t mea:
Just because you can attack
doesn’t mean you should!

When faced with a superior
foe, it may sometimes be
sensible to stand idle or
flee rather than strike and
trade away your hit-points.
entries.Is that all you’ve got? After so much bl: Is that all you’ve got? After so much bluster, I thought you would have been able to finish me off by now. I suppose lichdom isn’t all it’s cracked up to be.
entries.Yeah... figures that I wouldn’t get a ha: Yeah... should have expected that I wouldn’t get a happy ending. Good luck, rookie...
entries.A pathetic display. Westin will pose no: A pathetic display. Westin will pose no more of a challenge than did this rabble. March onwards, my skeletons! We’ll sweep through Westin and raze it to the ground!
entries.Pesky humans; you’ve delayed me, but not: Pesky humans; you’ve delayed me, but not for long. Westin will pose no more of a challenge than did this rabble. March onwards, my skeletons! We’ll sweep through Westin and raze it to the ground!
entries.Pesky little humans! You may have delaye: Pesky little humans! You may have delayed me, but my victory is inevitable. March onwards, my skeletons! We’ll sweep through Westin and raze it to the ground!
Pesky little humans! You may have delayed me for longer than expected, but my victory is inevitable. March onwards, my skeletons! We’ll sweep through Westin and raze it to the ground!
entries.Infuriating humans! How dare you survive: Infuriating humans! How dare you survive for so long? March onwards, my skeletons, we must now make haste! We’ll sweep through Westin and raze it to the ground!
entries.The sun does not shine underground.\n\nI:
The sun does not shine underground.

In caves and similarly dark places,
the time of day is always considered
nighttime.

Underground terrain is often
difficult to traverse, and can be 
full of choke-points. Mounted units,
such as Deoran, have a particularly
hard time.
entries.Mebrin is dead, Ethiliel. Afalas was rig: Mebrin is dead, Ethiliel. Afalas was right. I saw the lich Mal M’Brin with my own two eyes, heard his ravings with my own two ears! I watched him raise the dead out of the ground!
entries.Guess it’s time to take her down, then?: I suppose it’s time to take her down, then? Not my favourite plan, but what’s one little elf after an entire undead lich?
entries.I heard Afalas’s words. I watched Deoran: I heard Afalas’ words. I watched Deoran’s choice. I know Westin and the Urza brothers have conspired to kidnap our sage, but it is not too late! Give new orders to Deoran, to return Mebrin to his home!
entries.Figures this’d all be the rookie’s fault: Should have known this’d all be the rookie’s fault. I knew I should’ve gone with to keep him out of trouble... I suppose it’s up to us to keep the town safe.
Caught between a rock and a hard place. We can’t flee, or the elves would cut us down. Can’t attack, or we provoke an all-out war. I suppose our only option is to hold the town and hope the elves see sense.
entries.For Weldyn! For Westin! For our home!!: For Weldyn! For Westin! For our home!
entries.The elves demand that we produce someone: The elves demand that we produce someone called ‘Mebrin’ — I take it you know who that is? In his absence, we have instead focused our efforts on protecting the townsfolk.
entries.Figures this’d all be the rookie’s fault: Should have known this’d all be the rookie’s fault. While you’ve been running around causing problems, we’ve been trying to actually keep the town safe.
entries.Deoran, you have the most experience dea: Deoran, you have the most experience dealing with these elves, and a more complete understanding of the situation than do I. If you wish to command the defence, our soldiers are at your service.
entries.That’s assuming Weldyn would even bother: That’s assuming Weldyn would even bother to help a rural town as this. Capital of the southern province, sure, but that’s not saying much. Without Prince Arand’s ambitions for this place, I doubt anybody — you and me included — would much care what happened here.
entries.O’ course, if th’ prince had actually co: O’ course, if th’ prince had actually come here himself instead o’ spendin’ all ’is time up in Weldyn with the king, we might’ve not got into such trouble in th’ first place...
entries.Of course, if the prince had actually co: Of course, if the prince had actually come here himself instead of spending all his time up at Weldyn with the king, we might’ve not got in such trouble in the first place...
entries....yeah, I did. I heard them rangers in: ...yeah, I did. I heard them rangers in the forest south-ways, knew they’d be wantin’ my head. I could’a ran and hid, but I wanted to make things right. I went and found Mebrin’s bones, and brought them to the Aethenwood.
Many perished, including Mebrin himself. But after days of hard labour by both man and troll, we dug ourselves free and set out for Westin, bringing the skull of our vanquished foe. You recognize its elven features, Ethiliel, do you not?
entries.It takes one hell of a soldier to keep o: It takes one hell of a soldier to keep on fighting’ after losin’ an arm. I wish I’d got to know ’er better. Now I’ll never get the chance.
entries.Captain Mari bought us time — I only hop: Captain Mari bought us time — I only hope it was enough. A mighty battle is upon us, but as surely as the dawn breaks after every night, the courage and valour of men will prevail over the wicked creatures of darkness.
entries.Sir Gerrick bought us time — I only hope: Sir Gerrick bought us time — I only hope it was enough. A mighty battle is upon us, but as surely as the dawn breaks after every night, the courage and valour of men will prevail over the wicked creatures of darkness.
entries.Look there! The undead army has broken t: Look there! The undead army has broken through Minister Hylas’ lines! I had almost dared to hope... but alas, he is lost.
entries.Me, I’d have taken the life of luxury. B: Me, I’d have taken the life of luxury. But maybe the world needs crazy people like him — Hylas’ sacrifice bought us enough time to gather most of the region’s farmers and woodsmen. They’re not trained for battle, but will benefit greatly from your leadership, Deoran.

Me, I’d have taken the life of luxury. But maybe the world needs crazy people like him — Hylas’ sacrifice bought us enough time to gather most of the region’s farmers and woodsmen, as well as recall the small squad of mages manning Fort Tahn.

Me, I’d have taken the life of luxury. But maybe the world needs crazy people like him — Hylas’ sacrifice bought us enough time to gather, train, and equip most of the region’s farmers and woodsmen, as well as recall the small squad of mages manning Fort Tahn.
entries.Minister Hylas bought us time — I only h: Minister Hylas bought us time — I only hope it was enough. A mighty battle is upon us, but as surely as the dawn breaks after every night, the courage and valour of men will prevail over the wicked creatures of darkness.
entries.So, the fleshbags have managed to mount: So, the flesh-bags have managed to mount a defence. It would seem that the pesky fly turned out to be more than a minor annoyance after all.
entries.The shroud of darkness descends once mor: The shroud of darkness descends once more. Night seeps through the cracks and crannies in the humans’ defences, plaguing their minds and bodies with dreadful fear. As surely as the sanctity of the psyche is shattered, so is the physical form, and all that’s left is unthinking, unfeeling servitude.
entries.And when that’s done, what will us elves: And when that’s done, what will us elves have become? Nought but hungering shadows, devouring all we once cherished.
entries.Ethiliel I respect, but you? Destroy me?: Ethiliel I respect, but you? Destroy me? Your man-flesh will provide a fine feast for my ghouls, and once they’re through, your bones will serve me for ever in undeath!
entries.The fog drifted away, revealing Ethiliel: The fog drifted away, revealing Ethiliel and Deoran, facing the wall of spears side-by-side. Their faces were worn, masks of woe and exhaustion. Yet Deoran’s voice was startlingly clear as he spoke to the men of Wesnoth, saying: ‘Stop! Enough blood has been spilled today, human and elf alike. The Aethenwood is done fighting.’ In full view of the line of infantry, man and elf shook hands. Ethiliel made a full, lengthy, teary apology.
entries.The fog drifted away and Ethiliel stood: The fog drifted away and Ethiliel stood there alone, facing the wall of spears. Her face was a mask of woe and exhaustion, and yet her voice was startlingly clear as she spoke to the men of Wesnoth, saying: ‘Stop! My mistakes have spilled enough blood today, human and elf alike. The Aethenwood wishes to end our attack.’ Deoran rode to the forefront of the line of infantry, his hand outstretched. With a silent handshake, man and elf made peace.
entries.As the lich’s final death scream echoed:
As the lich’s final death scream echoed across the battlefield, his skeletal form began to crumble. His skull fell to the ground as decayed bones disintegrated into ash, borne away on the frigid wind, another immortal soul cast back into the endless flow of time.

With their master’s power gone, the undead warriors fell back to lifelessness, crumbling into inanimate heaps of bones. The rusting wind floated across the battlefield in gentle streams, carrying with it the souls of the fallen and ascending towards the sky where the sun began to break through the ashen clouds. As the sunlight broke through, the wind passed, and all was still.
entries.At length, Deoran led an expedition to t:
At length, Deoran led an expedition to the hamlet of Southport, where the cottages had been smashed into crumbled ruins, and blood and broken weapons were scattered all about. He silently cursed the lich for the lack of bodies at the site of the battle, but deep down, he’d known that would be the fate of the men who’d valiantly given their lives so that Westin might survive the undead onslaught.

Still, he found small consolation in locating Sir Gerrick’s glaive and shield and bearing them back with him to Westin. Those he placed atop Gerrick’s mound, where they became a symbol of sacrifice, loyalty and valour.

At length, Deoran led an expedition to the hamlet of Southport, where the cottages had been smashed into crumbled ruins, and blood and broken weapons were scattered all about. He silently cursed the lich for the lack of bodies at the site of the battle, but deep down, he’d known that would be the fate of the men who’d valiantly given their lives so that Westin might survive the undead onslaught.

Still, he found small consolation in locating Minister Hylas’s staff and book and bearing them back with him to Westin. Those he placed atop Hylas’s mound, where they became a symbol of sacrifice, loyalty and valour.

entries.The more talented cavalrymen in the armi: The more talented cavalrymen in the armies of Wesnoth are trained in the use of the crossbow, and matched with much more powerful steeds. As effective leaders and powerful warriors, these men patrol the countryside and eliminate any threats to peace in the frontier villages.
entries.The best and brightest of the heavy infa: The best and brightest of the heavy infantry are made responsible for the garrison and defence of border towns and villages. Fighting with unmatched power in melee combat, they are drawn from the ranks of veteran soldiers, not nobility, and all have shown great courage in battle. One of these veteran fighters in a battle line will stiffen it considerably.
entries.Quintains are used to practice swordplay: Quintains are used to practise swordplay and jousting on. It would be extremely unusual to be attacked by one.
entries.Fencers belong to a school of thought th:
Fencers belong to a school of thought that considers the armour most soldiers wear in combat to be their own worst enemy. While armour can only soften a blow, evading it leaves the defender completely unharmed. Being able to reliably dodge any offensive move is a luxury only afforded to the fit of body, and then only to those who endure rigorous training.

The occasional loss of limb is an unfortunate side effect of unarmoured combat. Though such an injury prevents the use of bows and crossbows, slings can be wielded one-handed, and make for a competent substitute.
entries.Click a mouse button or press the spaceb: Click a mouse button or press the space-bar to continue...
entries.I notice you’ve been loading a lot of sa: I notice you’ve been loading a lot of saved games. If this is how you prefer to play, power to you! But if you’re save-loading because hits and misses feel unfair, try restarting the campaign and selecting ‘Reduced RNG’ instead of ‘Default RNG’. You’re also welcome to turn down the difficulty: when you load a ‘start-of-scenario’ save, there’s a little ‘change difficulty’ box you can select. Alternatively, you may want to go back to a previous turn or even scenario, to choose a different strategy or carry over additional gold. We balance campaigns around minimal save-loading and have completed all campaigns without any save-loading during development. It’s not expected to beat campaigns without losses. Save-load all you want if it makes the game more fun, but don’t feel like you’re required to save-load in order to win!
entries.Yeah... I should’ve figured I wouldn’t g: Yeah... I should’ve expected I wouldn’t get a happy ending...
entries.One of your units has reached max XP, an: One of your units has reached maximum XP, and has advanced a level! It is now significantly more powerful, and has been fully healed! For a full description of what one of your units can do, right-click it and select ‘Unit Type Description.’
entries.\nMost scenarios have a turn limit, as\n: Most scenarios have a turn limit, as shown in the upper-left-hand corner. Usually, running out of turns will result in defeat — check your objectives by clicking the ‘Menu’ button in the top-left corner (or use the hot-key Ctrl+J). Finishing early will usually reward a gold boost (‘early finish bonus’) in the next scenario, so don’t delay!
entries.To see what damage resistances and vulne: To see what damage resistances and vulnerabilities a unit has, right-click it and select ‘Unit Type Description.’
entries.Wesnoth is a game about flexible strateg: Wesnoth is a game about flexible strategy, not deterministic calculation. Anyone can win when things go as planned. Wesnoth’s skill & mastery lie in creating a strategy that mitigates bad luck, while simultaneously exploits good luck. Both bad and good luck are inevitable, so be ready to handle both! Expert players are so skilled at this that they can prevail in every campaign on even the highest difficulty, without save-loading! That said, if you really prefer a more deterministic experience, try selecting ‘Reduced RNG’ when starting a new campaign.

In challenging scenarios, it's often
impossible to protect every unit.

Instead of sending your veterans 
straight into the meat-grinder, it's
often best to use them alongside
fresh recruits or disposable units.

Doing so can help spare your
veterans from the worst of the

entries.Ethiliel led the South Guard through the:
Ethiliel led the South Guard through the southern forest. The deep woods became overcast with unnatural shadow as they travelled, shrouded with eerie silence and uncanny stillness. Grey darkness sapped all colour from their murky surroundings, with every movement and sound muted in the thick fog. Their small company kept vigilant watch on the dense forest and on each other, wary of the foreboding ambience.

Finally, Ethiliel told them to halt and pitch camp — they had reached the Black River, beyond which no elf or man would willingly pass.
entries.Harried by an increasingly worried Ethil:
Harried by an increasingly worried Ethiliel, Deoran and his company marched quickly northwards out of the great southern forest.

Yet even as they returned towards the land of men, the ominous gloom of the forest followed them. Up above, the bright sun was shrouded with grey fog, overcast with billowing clouds streaking through the sky in streams of darkened ash. Behind, the crepuscular shadow spread outwards from the forest, an unnatural extension of the still-undefeated powers that lay within. It gained quickly upon them, the sinister darkness creeping ever-faster towards the men of the South Guard.
